signature.instructions: Given a medical text, analyze the content and identify the presence or absence of specific substances and general categories of substance use. Classify the text into the following categories: heroin use, cocaine use, methamphetamine use, benzodiazepine use, Rx opioid misuse, cannabis use, injection drug use, and general drug use. Produce a list of boolean values indicating the presence (True) or absence (False) of each category. For example, given the medical text "He denies use of benzos but his tox screen was positive for opioids and benzos," the output would be: heroin=False, cocaine=False, methamphetamine=False, benzodiazepine=True, rx_opioid_misuse=True, cannabis=False, injection_drug_use=False, general_drug_use=True. Use your language model capabilities to accurately analyze the medical text and make these classifications.
